gloss: perfect freedom; unhindered adaptability; complete flexibility

definitions.gloss: perfect freedom; unhindered adaptability; complete flexibility
definitions.explanation: The quality of being able to adapt freely and smoothly to any situation without being constrained by rigid rules or fixed thinking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発想|はっそう}→発想：04309_hassou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{融通無碍|ゆうずうむげ}だ。
{融通無碍|ゆうずうむげ}な⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}した→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The problem was solved through flexible, unhindered handling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{型|かた}→型：02146_kata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧とらわれない{融通無碍|ゆうずうむげ}な⟦{芸風|げいふう}→芸風：15160_geifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られ→知る：00458_shiru⟧、⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}り→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追求|ついきゅう}→追求：14401_tsuikyuu⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The master was known for a freely adaptable artistic style unconstrained by convention, always pursuing new forms of expression while preserving tradition.

notes:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) from Buddhist philosophy. ⟦{融通|ゆうずう}→融通：10914_yuuzuu⟧ means "mutual penetration" or "free interchange" (a concept in Huayan/Kegon Buddhism where all things are interconnected), and ⟦{無碍|むげ}→無碍：27062_muge⟧ means "without obstruction."

The word describes an ideal state of complete mental and practical freedom — the ability to respond to situations without being blocked by preconceptions or rigid patterns. It is used as high praise for someone's thinking, artistic expression, or way of handling problems.

Also written {融通無礙|ゆうずうむげ} with the variant kanji {礙|げ}. Can function as a na-adjective ({融通無碍|ゆうずうむげ}な).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {融通無碍|ゆうずうむげ}な⟦{発想|はっそう}→発想：04309_hassou⟧: unconstrained thinking
- {融通無碍|ゆうずうむげ}な⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: flexible response
- {融通無碍|ゆうずうむげ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧: to behave with complete freedom

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自由自在|じゆうじざい}→自由自在：21838_jiyuujizai⟧: freely; at will (similar meaning but less literary)
- ⟦{臨機応変|りんきおうへん}→臨機応変：05663_rinkiouhen⟧: adapting to circumstances (focuses on situational response)
- ⟦{柔軟|じゅうなん}→柔軟：13101_juunan⟧: flexible (everyday word, less elevated)
